prompt: Two luminous spirit figures facing each other in a soft glowing void, communicating mind to mind — no mouths moving, a gentle ribbon of light and tiny symbols flowing directly between their foreheads, thought passing without speech.

A lone figure standing at the edge of an otherworldly landscape ablaze with impossible luminous colors never seen on earth — hues beyond the rainbow shimmering in the sky, the hills, the water, more vivid and alive than any earthly color.

A figure standing in a vivid, crystal-clear, hyper-real heavenly landscape where everything is intensely present and solid, while behind them the ordinary earthly world — a grey city street — is drawn faded and blurry like a half-remembered foggy dream.

A figure with head tilted back and eyes closed as radiant light pours into their mind, surrounded by a swirling galaxy of stars, symbols and answered questions — the feeling of suddenly knowing everything at once.

A figure standing with eyes closed, bathed in celestial music made visible — glowing waves and ribbons of sound pouring down from a choir of soft luminous angelic forms above, the very air and grass vibrating with music.

A figure kneeling and gently touching a field of tall luminous living grass — each blade glowing softly from within and leaning toward the figure with love, a warm golden light emanating from the whole meadow.

A figure floating in a dark gentle void, surrounded on all sides by softly glowing floating scenes of their own life — small memory-windows hovering in the air, some happy, some painful, all playing at once.
A figure walking into a warm embracing light at the end of a soft path, greeted by the open arms of glowing welcoming presences — the overwhelming feeling of finally arriving home, tender and safe.
